propositions: The live-DC readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but does not verify that required custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, creating a timing window where the instance is declared ready but fields are not yet available.

A system-only field inventory (27 system fields, zero customfield_* entries) returned one second after serverInfo answered 200 proves that plugin field provisioning lags behind the HTTP readiness signal.

The harness survives this gap only because it runs slow work (dependency install, 41-minute suite) before reaching _assert_project_capabilities, masking the latent flake that the probe encounters immediately.
The probe workflow (Gerrit 1387) was fixed to poll the field inventory but the harness was left on serverInfo, creating two divergent readiness definitions that can drift and re-introduce the bug.

_assert_project_capabilities cannot distinguish between 'fields not registered yet' and 'image does not offer these fields' when readiness was declared without verifying field presence, causing timing flakes to be misattributed to image degrades.
Readiness must be shared, gated on the capability (field presence) not a proxy (serverInfo 200), with a bounded budget and self-diagnosing failure message that dumps the observed inventory.
